name: Bepinex5.Android
summary: Game-agnostic BepInEx 5 LTS port for Unity Mono Android. Replaces Doorstop with a JNI shim, repacks the APK, and patches the Preloader.
breakingChanges: Doorstop is not used; libbe5hook.so is loaded via System.loadLibrary from patched classes.dex
Game assemblies are unpacked from assets/bin/Data/Managed into app data on first launch
The shipped APK must be repacked and re-signed; there is no drop-in install
Preloader resolves the Managed directory at runtime instead of a build-time path
Assembly names and namespaces are intentionally unchanged for mod compatibility
